=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- unattended_system_instructions.md:78-94 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The global instructions claim web search is available unconditionally even though some phases explicitly disable it.
  WHY: implement.yml and review_autofix.yml pass `--web-search disabled`, so the same phase-mismatch was independently reported by five reviewers; moonshot labeled it critical while the others reported the same runtime misguidance with high confidence.
- prompts/mode-clarify.txt:10-34 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The clarify prompt gives conflicting instructions for non-derivable external inputs, sometimes telling the model to emit BLOCKED and elsewhere to proceed with STATUS: CLEAR.
  WHY: Four reviewers reported the same BLOCKED-vs-CLEAR inconsistency; moonshot labeled it medium priority while the others described the same contradictory pipeline outcomes with high confidence.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:132-153 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The sweep hardcodes `allow_workflow_edits=true`, bypassing the repository opt-out for workflow edits.
  WHY: Five reviewers independently reported that the dispatch step unconditionally forwards `true` instead of respecting `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS`; moonshot labeled this critical.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:1-162 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The cron sweep processes every open non-draft PR with no per-tick cap, so its cost scales unboundedly with repository size.
  WHY: Five reviewers reported the same uncapped dispatch pattern and quota/CI-minute growth risk; moonshot labeled it medium priority while the others described the same cost growth with high confidence.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:333-334 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The default for `AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED` now skips less often, causing self-triggered synchronize events to rerun the full review cycle.
  WHY: Four reviewers reported the same default flip as an LLM-spend regression; no reviewer reported a different root cause for this behavior change.
- README.md:70 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The README still documents the old default for `AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED`.
  WHY: The documented default conflicts with the actual gate default in `review_autofix.yml:333`, which can mislead operators about behavior and cost.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
(No findings reported.)
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- unattended_system_instructions.md:85-92 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The global instructions claim web search is available, but both implement.yml and review_autofix.yml disable it.
  WHY: Agents in those phases will be told to use `web_search` even though the workflow passes `--web-search disabled`.
- prompts/mode-clarify.txt:12-15 vs 27-31 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Two contradictory rules exist for non-derivable values versus external data that cannot be derived.
  WHY: One rule says to emit exactly `BLOCKED: <short reason>`, while another says to set `STATUS: CLEAR`, so similar inputs can produce different pipeline outcomes.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:1-162 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new cron sweep iterates over all open non-draft PRs every 30 minutes without any cap.
  WHY: As PR count grows, each cycle can trigger many full autofix runs and consume significant quota and CI minutes.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:151-152 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The dispatch step hardcodes `-f allow_workflow_edits=true` unconditionally, bypassing repo-level opt-out.
  WHY: Repos that set `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=false` will have that setting overridden by the sweep dispatch.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:333 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The default for `AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED` flipped, so synchronize events now trigger a full review rerun instead of skipping self-triggered pushes.
  WHY: This increases LLM spend per autofix iteration with no compensating benefit on non-sweep paths.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- unattended_system_instructions.md:81-88 | severity=critical
  PROBLEM: The text states "web search is available" as universal guidance, but this is incorrect for implement and review phases which explicitly disable web search.
  WHY: This file is loaded as system context for ALL phases, while `.github/workflows/implement.yml:884` and `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1248` pass `--web-search disabled`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:132-141 | severity=critical
  PROBLEM: Hardcodes `-f allow_workflow_edits=true` unconditionally when dispatching internal-review.yml.
  WHY: This bypasses the `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS` repository variable protection and enables workflow edits even when the operator has opted out.
- prompts/mode-clarify.txt:14-17 vs 27-29 | severity=medium
  PROBLEM: Potentially conflicting guidance exists on handling non-derivable external data.
  WHY: The BLOCKED rule applies to specific scalar values, while the STATUS: CLEAR rule applies to broader external data, which can still be interpreted inconsistently.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:47-162 | severity=medium
  PROBLEM: No cap limits the number of PRs processed per sweep iteration.
  WHY: The workflow can dispatch a full review run for every matching PR on each cron tick, which can consume significant LLM quota and CI minutes.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:333 | severity=medium
  PROBLEM: The default changed to false so every synchronize event, including self-[ai-autofix] pushes, now triggers a full review rerun instead of skipping.
  WHY: This increases LLM spend per autofix iteration without a compensating correctness gain on the synchronize path.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- unattended_system_instructions.md:78-94
  PROBLEM: The amended text says web search is available as a universal statement even though some phases explicitly disable it.
  WHY: `.github/workflows/implement.yml:884` and `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1248` both pass `--web-search disabled`, so the instruction misleads implement and review_autofix paths.
- prompts/mode-clarify.txt:12-21 vs 27-33
  PROBLEM: The new BLOCKED rule and the STATUS: CLEAR rule give different pipeline outcomes for similar non-derivable inputs.
  WHY: A model can select either path for external-data gaps, producing inconsistent clarify outputs and downstream orchestration behavior.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:132-141
  PROBLEM: The dispatch hardcodes `allow_workflow_edits=true` when invoking internal-review.yml.
  WHY: The repo variable `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS` is not consulted, so any opt-out is silently overridden by the sweep.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:1-162
  PROBLEM: The sweep enumerates every open non-draft PR and dispatches internal-review.yml for each one with no per-tick cap.
  WHY: On repos with many open PRs, each 30-minute tick can trigger full review pipelines for every match and exhaust API/CI/LLM budgets.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:333
  PROBLEM: The `AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED` gate now defaults to false, so synchronize events from [ai-autofix] pushes run the full review panel instead of being skipped.
  WHY: This doubles LLM spend per autofix iteration on the synchronize path.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
